eras.title: Steps emerging from the forest
eras.caption: At Naranjo, stone stairways and temple platforms rise among forested hills. Excavation reveals only parts of a larger Maya capital, where palaces, plazas and elevated ceremonial groups were arranged across the uneven ground.
